strings.tutorial.associations.l1.start: Tap a category card, then tap an empty slot to open it.
strings.tutorial.associations.l1.category: Now tap a matching word, then tap its category.
strings.tutorial.associations.l2.start: Tap the deck to draw a card. Every move counts!
strings.tutorial.tripeaks.l1.start: Tap a card one higher or one lower than the open card. Clear the whole board!
strings.tutorial.tripeaks.l3.start: Long runs score more. Draw from the deck only when nothing fits.
